exposure.needed: whether the environment installs external-secrets CRDs separately rather than through the chart

consequence.statement: Where CRDs are installed separately, the CRD bundle must be bumped to v0.16.1 before external-secrets is upgraded, and the operator must check that no error occurs.
consequence.remediation: kubectl apply -f https://raw.githubusercontent.com/external-secrets/external-secrets/v0.16.1/deploy/crds/bundle.yaml, check that no error occurs, then upgrade external-secrets to v0.16.1.

assertion.statement: When CRDs are installed separately, operators must first bump the CRDs by applying the v0.16.1 deploy/crds/bundle.yaml and check that no error occurs, and only then upgrade external-secrets to v0.16.1.

checks.detail: no canonical exposure condition for migration migration-required
